notes.title: Patch Notes - August 15th
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44541356/c6f2d00068aa7789b43e94e587b4c4bfa756647d.png[/img]

Hello Sparks, 

Today is release day for Phantom Spark, and whilst there have been a few bugs reported, we’re pleased to share our first patch including bug fixes!

[b]Feedback Points[/b]
[list]
[*]Key rebind, where? We hear you loud and clear! 
Feedback Logged + Workaround for Steam Deck: For our SteamDeck players, you can use a workaround with Steam API via this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2804823261]link[/url]

[*]Manually select flag to represent your region.
Feedback Logged: Thank you for the request! 

[*]Track Building, create your own tracks.
Feedback Logged: Thank you for all the requests! We’re glad to see you are enjoying Phantom Spark and would like to create your own tracks. We have logged your feedback request and will update you in the future!
[/list]

[b]Bugs Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*]Player names appearing as anonymous for the first time playing.
FIXED: You are no longer anonymous! Your name should now appear. If you are still encountering this bug, please close the game down, restart, and check. 

[*]Game freezing when not in window focus.
FIXED: Your game should no longer freeze when you alt tab/click off screen. 

[*]Game not launching due to audio issue.
TEMP FIX: If there is an issue with audio, the game will still launch without audio, rather than freeze. (We still hope to resolve the audio issues but at least you can play…)

[*]Username not showing up on leaderboards.
FIXED: Your usernames should now be appearing on leaderboards! Make sure to restart your game and check for patches, if you are still encountering this bug. 

[*]Music on pathways not changing from Idle and into new soundtrack variants.
TEMP FIX: Pausing the game, and unpausing, should force the music to update from Idle and into a new track. 
[/list]

As always, thank you for sharing all of your feedback and any bugs you encounter. Please do continue to share your bugs with us in the official [url=https://discord.gg/9bmYZceC]Discord [/url]

notes.title: Phantom Spark is in Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Steam Next Fest is here and so are the demos! Did we mention that there's a Phantom Spark Demo with online leaderboards for the entirety of the event? THERE'S A PHANTOM SPARK DEMO OUT RIGHT NOW!

That's right, you can jump into the high speed world of Phantom Spark right now and make your mark on the online leaderboards. Set your mind to it and take on the pathways available in the demo, in our precision time-trial racer.

The demo is available throughout the event, which runs from June 10th to June 17th, don't miss your chance to try Phantom Spark out.

notes.title: Phantom Spark is a hover racer of impeccable chill and wistful fantasy worldbuilding
notes.notes:
I was a diehard WipeOut player as a kid. Seriously, me and the boys used to roam the streets of Bradford looking for F-Zero players to bully, at least till the RollCagers rocked up and stole our lunch money. Mind you, I think I was probably less interested in WipeoUt's racing than its trackside landscapes, which remain exquisite decades on - all those sweeping album-cover facades with their animate fixtures that thickened and solidified into full-blown peripheral cities as the series progressed.

I am similarly hooked by the worlds of Ghosts Ehf's Phantom Spark, which are a million lightyears from WiPeout in terms of their influences and atmosphere, much as the underlying hover-jockeying is a million lightyears away from WipeouT in terms of its gentleness and lack of combative elements. But these spaces are just as mesmerising to fly through and think about when not focussed on finding the perfect line through the next corner, or avoiding a patch of grass. Small wonder, given that the game's art director is Joost Eggermont, whose streaking astral contraptions and "small interactive moments" I've long admired, but never managed to write about until now.

notes.title: Phantom Spark - Closed Alpha Playtest
notes.notes:
Greetings Seekers! ✨

We're very excited to invite you to our closed alpha playtest for Phantom Spark happening this weekend!

Master the ancient tracks of Tyvahl in this high-speed, gravity-defying time-trial racer. Meet the guardians and best them in head-to-head competition. Challenge your friends in split-screen local multiplayer or take on the best in the world via online leaderboards.

Sign up now via our Google form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeMlyumXoflOwac5kfUnimuQ9WD_dwARS4ngC8kO_nm7h1mrA/viewform?usp=sf_link 

[b]Playtest Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] Open from Monday (Feb 12, 2024) until Sunday (Feb 18, 2024).
[*] Play the full game as much as you like over the time period and let us know what you think!
[*] If you encounter anything during the game - bugs, a question, something that looks off - you can press F11 to open up a feedback window. This is hugely helpful for us, as we can see in context what is going wrong in the relevant context which will make it easier to fix.
[*] When you are finished, fill out the survey to let us know what you thought!
[/list]

We can't wait to see what you think! See you on the tracks! ✨

notes.title: Introducing Phantom Spark
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Q1FKWJVX5OE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Phantom Spark[/h3]
Phantom Spark is an all-new, momentum-based, time-trial racing game that encourages you to smash time trial records with no speed limit holding you back throughout its weaving, rollercoaster-like levels. Face off in heated rivalries throughout the single-player campaign as you attempt to smash the record on each track throughout the world of Phantom Spark. Make sure to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1924180/Phantom_Spark/]wishlist the game now[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1924180/Phantom_Spark/

[h3]Become the Best[/h3]
With easy-to-learn but hard-to-master gameplay, Phantom Spark offers the player the chance to improve their time on each track through knowledge of every twist and turn, mastery over their ship and the willingness to bend the laws of physics.

[h3]Beat the Best[/h3]
Throughout our single-player campaign, you will meet the guardians of every track, utilise your knowledge and skills to beat them in 1-on-1 races in order to create links, unlock new levels, new cosmetically altered ships as you progress throughout the game.

[h3]Beat the Rest[/h3]
With online leaderboards and the ghosts of other players, you can compete against your friends and forge new online rivalries with other players as you bid to post the perfect time on over 30+ tracks.

[h3]Join the Community[/h3]
Stay up-to-date with the latest on all things Phantom Spark and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/_PhantomSpark]Twitter[/url] & [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@_phantomspark]Tiktok[/url]. And join the [url=https://discord.gg/coatsink]Discord[/url] to find like minded racers and learn more about Phantom Sparks development.
